title: LearnOps course package (B1, v1)
description: The parsed content of course.yaml in a course package (PRD B1.1). Markdown bodies and assets sit beside it and are not described here. This schema checks structure only; rules that need a view of the whole course (PRD B1.2, B1.3, B1.4) are listed under $comment and are enforced by validator code, not by this file.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced here: B1.2 rule 1 (exactly one guide Page and one task Assignment per week), rule 2 (week N unlocks when the week N-1 task is submitted; unlock.after must name an earlier activity), rule 3 (graded points sum to total_points), rule 5 (completion tracking on for every activity used in an unlock rule), rule 6 (idnumbers unique within the course and never reused); B1.3 (marking table inside the assignment body: markers, columns, points sum, allowed Check values); B1.4 (protected idnumbers other than the two defaults, and section numbers that collide with the configurable protected_section). start_date is checked for calendar validity only when the validator is run with a format checker; the pattern guarantees the YYYY-MM-DD shape either way.

identifier.description: Lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens (PRD B1.1 slug, B1.2 rule 6 idnumber). The end anchor is (?![\s\S]) instead of $ because Python's $ also matches before a trailing newline.

allOf.description: Default protected idnumbers (PRD B1.4). They are owned by the course template and must never appear in a package, in either mode. Extra protected idnumbers a site configures are checked by validator code.

relative_path.description: Path inside the package folder, with forward slashes. Not a URL, not absolute, no '..' segment (PRD C-08 spirit: relative paths only).

shortname.description: Stable; matches the Moodle course shortname.

slug.description: Immutable; media paths use it (PRD B1.1).

total_points.description: Graded points across the course sum to this (PRD B1.2 rule 3; default 100).

mode.description: full generates a whole course; sections-only generates only the listed week sections for merging into a template course (PRD B1.4).

after.description: idnumber of the activity that must be complete (submitted) first; null for the first week.

start_date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Keep it quoted in YAML so it stays a string.

body.description: Markdown file for the activity. For an assignment it must contain a marking table (PRD B1.3).

completion.description: submit: the activity is complete when the learner submits (PRD B1.2 rule 2).

then.description: H5P practice is never graded (PRD B7).
